subject: FinOps trial: Costly.ai conversion playbook and next steps
messages:
From: Jamie Park <jamie@costly.ai>
To: rohan_mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-14T09:23:00-07:00
Subject: Costly.ai trial wrap + recommended conversion plan

Hi Rohan —

Thanks again for running the two-week trial of Costly.ai across the inference fleet. We pulled the usage and savings summary for the trial accounts and attached a short PDF (costly-trial-report.pdf). Highlights:
- Estimated 18% overall token-cost reduction on the batching-heavy routes.
- Peak latency impact within your SLO for 95% of requests; a small bump during bursts.
- Identified three deployment routes where prefix caching reduced repeat tokens by ~28%.

If you’re comfortable, the next step is a pilot-to-production conversion: a 3-month paid seat with reserved capacity and a short implementation package (SSO, billing integration, S3 exports). I can share an updated quote and DocuSign when you’re ready.

Attached: costly-trial-report.pdf

Best,
Jamie Park
Enterprise Sales, Costly.ai

From: rohan_mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Park <jamie@costly.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-14T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Costly.ai trial wrap + recommended conversion plan

Thanks Jamie — appreciate the quick summary and the PDF. Looping in Marissa and Ben so we can align commercial + finance. A few clarifying items before we take the quote to legal/procurement:

1) Can you break down the cost impact by environment (prod vs staging) and by model route? We want scoped numbers for the five highest-volume routes.
2) Any SKU-level minimums for reserved capacity?
3) Do you support SSO via our Okta tenant and SAML 2.0 IdP?
4) Can you provide a sample SLA for reserved pools and an incident communication template?

If it helps, we’ll prepare a short conversion playbook (operational tasks, owners, dates) on our side. Proposed internal timeline: decision by 2026-05-20, kickoff 2026-06-01.

Thanks,
Rohan
Senior Product Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: rohan_mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-15T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Costly.ai trial wrap + recommended conversion plan

Team — quick internal note before we go back to Jamie:

- Sales position: target a 12% discount on the 3-month reserved package in exchange for a 6-week implementation window. We can stretch to 15% if they include the SSO and two training sessions.
- Finance: need the environment breakdown Rohan requested to validate claimed savings against our billing export (CloudVendor billing + internal tagging).
- Procurement: ask for standard T&Cs with a 30-day termination right for pilot-to-prod conversions. Legal may want the SLA and data handling addendum.

I’ll draft a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) and share before EOD so we have something to send with counter-ask. Ben — can you run the cost-model against the trial numbers and flag any optimistic assumptions?

—Marissa
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Jamie Park <jamie@costly.ai>
To: rohan_mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-15T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Costly.ai trial wrap + recommended conversion plan

Appreciate the details. Attached updated quote (quote-v2.pdf) and an implementation checklist. To answer questions quickly:
- We can break down costs by route; I’ve included a per-route CSV in the quote bundle.
- Reserved pool min: 2 GPUs per pool; flexible burst options.
- SSO: full Okta SAML support, pre-configured connector available.
- SLA: 99.9% for reserved pools, 95th percentile latency objective on shared pools; we’ll send a formal SLA template for review.

If you have internal sign-off by 5/20 we’ll schedule onboarding and prioritize a dedicated success engineer during the first month. DocuSign link: https://app.costly.ai/quote/CSTLY-2026-093

Attachments: quote-v2.pdf

Best,
Jamie

- Commercial: accept quote-v2 with a 12% conversion credit and two training sessions included.
- Security/SSO: Costly.ai to provide Okta SAML connector and security questionnaire responses by 5/21.
- Technical validation: Rishi to sign off on final cost model by 5/19 (Ben to support).
- Legal/procurement: Laura to review T&Cs and SLA; target DocuSign completion by 5/24.
- Kickoff: tentative 2026-06-01 onboarding call; success engineer to be assigned at signing.

Action items owners:
- Jamie: send updated DocuSign with agreed credit + implementation bundle (link or attachment).
- Laura: send any required procurement checklist and NDA notes to Jamie.
- Rishi/Ben: validate cost model and return notes.
- Marissa: finalize MAP and communicate commercial acceptance to Costly sales ops.

Jamie — please confirm you accept these items and post the DocuSign link. If we’re aligned, we’ll have Legal loop in purchase order steps.
